title: 1000題題庫建置規格
qualityGates: 每題四個選項且只有一個正確答案（非選題需另訂評分規準）
答案與解析經人工或雙重規則檢查
標記課綱版本、年級、科目、單元與能力指標
歷屆考點衍生題需記錄考試名稱與年度，不複製受保護原文
避免跨年級重複題與只改數字的低品質重複題
每批執行重複題、答案索引、欄位完整性及語法檢查

integrationAuditNote: 2026-11-12 main branch audit found two issues: batch23 existed but was not loaded by the then-current index.html or sw.js, and index.html contained a literal tool-output truncation marker inside inline JavaScript causing a syntax error. Restored the last known syntactically valid UTF-8 index.html from commit 193134e95bc9caa682b349d14adf91562528d2b6, then re-added academic competition batch 04-07 script tags and question bank batch24 integration. Service Worker v34 lists question bank batches 08-24 and academic competition batches 01-07. Browser-level interaction testing remains unperformed. 2026-11-12 batch27 audit: immediately before integration, main contained original question-bank batches 08-26, index.html loaded and filtered batches 08-26, and Service Worker cache was v43 with academic competition assets 01-12. Added batch27 to index script loading and bankFor() filtering, and added its Service Worker asset while preserving academic batches 01-12 and existing image assets. Cache advanced to v44. Browser-level interaction testing and teacher review remain unperformed. 2026-11-13 batch28 audit: main baseline was batches08-27 (1,500 questions, 1,500 unique IDs), index.html loaded and filtered batches08-27, and Service Worker was v48 with academic competition batches01-14 and image assets. Added batch28 to index script loading and bankFor() filtering, advanced Service Worker to v49 and added its asset, while preserving all prior question banks and academic competition assets. Browser-level interaction testing and teacher review remain unperformed. Post-commit audit found b28-045 duplicated the normalized stem of b19-033; replaced it with a quadratic-vertex item and recorded the correction. Cross-batch exact-stem verification was repeated after the fix. A further item-quality pass refined distractors in selected questions and replaced one grade-5 sound item with a more age-appropriate vibration observation; count and IDs remain unchanged.
